newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Byblos Bank plans new Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Byblos Bank plans new Eurobond.

text.p: Lebanon's Byblos Bank, which issued a $50 million Eurobond in September, plans a new issue this year for at least that amount, a Byblos executive said on Monday.
"For sure we have in mind to come back into the market this year but it won't be before April," Gerard Charvet, deputy general manager of Byblos Bank told Reuters by telephone.
"It could be for more than $50 million but it's too early to mention figures. It won't be less, for sure," Charvet added.
Byblos, one of the most dynamic among Lebanon's 82 commercial banks, ranked seventh in 1995 in customer deposits. Its first Eurobond was heavily oversubscribed.
It plans to list its shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange shortly, Charvet said.
